articles.title: What is SecureFax® and how to send one
articles.body_html:
Here, we will show you how to send a SecureFax® by both using the platform and by email.

 

For information on how to receive faxes by SecureFax® and there notifications click here.

 

What is SecureFax®?

SecureFAX® can be useful for both, sending or receiving. In either case, the user can ensure security and proof of delivery.

Why choose SecureFax®?

There are several reasons why SecureFAX® may be used. One is to protect the information and make it available only for the intended recipients. SecureFAX® allows you to send information securely and track the receipt of financial, HR, legal, and medical records.

SecureFAX® was built to keep important data safe from cybercriminals, eavesdroppers and other threats in the modern digital world. SecureFAX® was designed by security experts and uses best-in-class encryption.

Another reason to use SecureFAX® is proof of delivery and guarantee that a document has reached a specific destination. Email administrators can sometimes disable delivery slips to avoid email spamming (also case for specific email clients, such as Outlook), so it is impossible to have proof that the document reached the destination or has been viewed by the recipient on his/her computer screen.

A common example where users can benefit from using SecureFAX® is for sending invoices to ensure they have been received by their customers which can help to reduce DSO.

When sending a document with this method, the system ensures that a message was delivered to the destination through a secure channel (TLS email server must be enabled) and that a message with a hyperlink was sent. The recipient then has to open the hyperlink and authenticate to view the document. If the customer is not registered on the platform, they will have to validate access for the first time using two-factor authentication procedure (an SMS code will be sent to their mobile phone). When the message is viewed on the recipients screen, a message notification is sent back to the sender with information that the message was opened and viewed.

SecureFAX® is a method used to send document(s) and to certify the following:

  • The message can only be transmitted through a TLS connection;
  • Whether or not the document was opened;
  • To ensure that the document reached the destination and was opened even, if the recipient did not have the necessary client to view the type/format of the document;
  • No interception or sniffing of the message was

Even if sender’s customer has no MS Excel, the sender may send an invoice spreadsheet and get a confirmation that the fax was viewed on the destination screen. SecureFAX® documents are addressed to an email address vs a fax line and eComFax® server will only accept jobs coming from domains that have enabled TLS secure transmission in order to maintain security standards. A SecureFAX® can be sent to any destination email address.

SecureFAX® also allows the recall of a document sent by mistake. In this case, the system will delete the document that was sent as long as it has not yet been viewed by the destination recipient.

 

To send via the Web Interface

Once logged in and on the home screen, choose the “New Fax” icon/tab.

Subsequently, choose the addressee/recipient or create a new recipient by clicking on the “+” symbol. When choosing a type of fax to-be-sent, please note that for Normal and CertiFAX® a fax number should be specified, while an email address is specified for SecureFAX® and PCIFAX®.

After that, choose if the document has a cover page or not, input the text for the cover page and attach the file(s) to-be-sent.

 

Sending via Email

In order to send a SecureFAX® via email, please input the email of the recipient in the following format:

In the “To:” field, put the destination email address but replace the “@“ for a “+” symbol followed by “@securefax.ecomfax.com” (to send without a cover page) or “@securefaxp.ecomfax.com” (to send with a cover page.)  For instance:

Peter.drove+company.com@securefax.ecomfax.com

or

Peter.drove+company.com@securefaxp.ecomfax.com

 

Start the SUBJECT with the PIN Code and then write the subject. The subject will be included on the cover notes. Do not leave a blank space between the PIN and the first word of the subject. (please note that PIN code is not needed in case of DKIM validation or if you are in the Enterprise subscription).

 

If a SecureFAX® is sent without any attachments and cover page, the user will receive an error message.

articles.title: Receiving Secure Faxes and SecrueFax® notifications
articles.body_html:
In this article we will explain how recipients receive a SecureFax® and also notifications. For information on how to send a SecureFax® click here.

 

Receiving a SecureFax®

Once a SecureFAX® is sent, the recipient will receive a message via email with “SecureFax” in the subject field and an indication who it is from. This email will have a link that the recipient will need to access and when clicked, a new window will appear inside the eComFax application.

When a SecureFAX® is sent to an individual who has never used the eComFax® service, this recipient should register to the application as an External user. These users will then be able to access the eComFax® application with very limited functionality in order to view the received fax content.

When accessing the platform for the first time, the application will ask the recipient for a password (to-be-entered twice) and a mobile phone number. After a few seconds, a SMS will be received to the provided mobile number with an activation code which should be input into the login window in order to access the application.

Upon successful login, the (External) user(s) (recipient(s)) will immediately see the document and its content. If they close the document window, they will see the eComFax® interface (as a new user) in which they can see all received messages under the “Message List”, along with the entire access history information (such as reception/expiration date, who has accessed the document, and other information).

In addition, the received document may also be downloaded (again, full traceability implied).

 

Setting all incoming faxes as SecureFax®

A DID may be assigned also to receive faxes via SecureFAX®. There may be several reasons to use SecureFAX® as a receiving method instead of email delivery. For instance, one may not want email administrator or ISP accessing the content or intercepting fax messages.

By delivering incoming faxes through SecureFAX®, the email of an incoming fax only contains a link and not the attachment itself. In order to access the document,  the user has to be logged in to the eComFax webpage and once logged in, they may view the content using a secure HTTPs connection.

You can set this feature by adjusting the information on your fax number, you can find out how to here.

 

SecureFax® Notifications

SecureFAX® has a set of notifications to inform the sender about the fax transmission.

When a user signs up for eComFax®, they will indicate the email address which all the messages and notifications should be sent to. Furthermore, eComFax® allows up to three different emails for the same function.

Tip: if you are an Enterprise user, the sender of the fax will receive the notifications.

As soon as a SecureFAX® is sent, a notification of this activity is received. In case the message was sent by error, recipient’s access to the document may also be disabled.

In case the recipient has not opened the document in the pre-determined time frame, the sender will receive a notification message about the expiration date and the option to extend the expiration date by resending the message with the link to the recipient once again.

Conversely, if the recipient does access the document, the sender will receive a notification message with the date and time when the document was accessed. This email may be kept as a proof that the document was viewed by the addressee/recipient with 100% certainty.

articles.title: What is CertiFAX® and how to send one
articles.body_html:
Here you will learn more about CertiFAX® and how they are sent, for the operations of CertiFAX® please click here.

 

What is CertiFax®?

Some companies need proof that a fax document has been sent without any doubt. Consequently, they may use that proof in a legal process with the guarantee that the communication occurred at a specific date and time, that the content was a specific one (as a proof of authenticity), that the communication occurred between two addresses and that an independent third party guarantees this indeed happened.

This is the aim of CertiFAX®. When a fax is sent using this method, the information about the sender, recipient(s), content, and fax metadata are digitally signed (using a certificate issued by a Certification Authority). Furthermore, a Digital Time Stamp (issued by a legal TSA) and a PDF certificate are issued and sent to the sender, capturing all – above-noted – information concerning authenticity what can subsequently be used in a possible legal process.

The certificate is issued by CWS as a 3rd party trust processor to certify that the content, as it is shown in the PDF certificate, was indeed sent from the number of the sender and addressed to the destination at that date and time. Delivery Certificates are kept securely on the platform for a period of 5 years.

Similar to a normal Fax, there are two options for sending a CertiFAX®, via navigating the web interface or via email.

 

Sending from the Web interface.

Once logged-in and on the home screen, the user chooses the “New Fax” icon.

In the following window choose the recipient or create a new recipient by clicking on the “+” symbol and choose “CertiFax” as the Fax type. This means that the user must input the fax number of the destination.

The user input's the text for the cover page, and finally attach the file(s) to-be-sent as a fax.

Tip: The cover page is mandatory with CertiFAX®

 

Sending from your email client

In order to send a CertiFAX®, indicate in the “To” field the following email address: faxnumber@certifax.ecomfax.com.

As an example, the following should be done:

  • To send a fax to a number ‘1212444333’, write the following address 1212444333@certifax.ecomfax.com;

  • Fill in the “Subject” field starting with user’s PIN code. A PIN Code is a 4-digit number that must be placed at the very beginning of the subject field. This is used for security purposes. Please do not leave a space between the PIN and the SUBJECT content. The PIN code can be accessed from eComFax web interface under <Configuration> tab, section “Delivery”;

Tip: Enterprise customers with domain set up also do not need the PIN

Note: In case DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM) validation technique is used, PIN entry is not needed. DKIM is an email authentication method designed to detect forged sender addresses in emails (email spoofing), a technique often used in phishing and email spam. It is specific to email provider; some may have this technique implemented while some not (eg. Microsoft Office 365 has DKIM built-in).

  • Attach the document that should be send via fax;
  • Please note that only the attachment(s) will be sent. The body of the email will be ignored;
  • Click “Send” button.

articles.title: Operations of CertiFAX®
articles.body_html:
Here is the information on the operations of CertiFAX®, for information about CertiFAX® and how to send one please click here.

 

Once a CertiFAX® is sent, the recipient receives a fax and the result of the whole process is digitally signed and sent back to the sender as a certified legal proof of delivery.

The certified fax includes a locator in the top area of the cover page. This locator allows review of the fax information and its content. The sender can also access the operations’ history by indicating the locator code on the client’s CertiFAX® website. This is also accessible through the QR code that appears on the cover page.

 

CertiFAX® tracks access to the CertiFAX® website and has several mechanism to ban unauthorized access.

The first page of the certified fax includes a QR code in the top, right-hand area. The certification report of delivery includes this same QR code on the first page in the bottom, right-hand area. This QR code contains the same information as shown in the previously mentioned locator.

The QR code can be scanned by using mobile devices in order to directly access the CertiFAX® website and show the information associated with the certified fax and the available operations.

 

Checking CertiFAXes

The user may want to keep the certificate for legal purposes. The certificate can be downloaded at any time by accessing the CertiFAX® website and using the QR Code. Accessing the “Message List” through the web interface, the user may check the status of all CertiFAXes.

 

 

Furthermore, from the history of the client’s CertiFAX® website the user can see if a download has been requested by the recipient of the certified fax and when they accessed the certified fax. The remote, masked IP address is also registered; which is a requirement for Data Protection Regulations.

articles.title: What is PCIFax® and how to send one?
articles.body_html:
Here will tell you what a PCIFax® is, how to send one and how to configure to receive all faxes as PCIFax®.

 

This method is used to send or receive documents with sensitive content; for instance, documents that contain private Credit Card information. Using this method, a sender sends documents in a similar way as with SecureFAX® but in order to comply with PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry – Data Security Standards), the following restrictions are implied:

  • Documents can not be printed;
  • Documents can not be forwarded;
  • Documents can not be downloaded;
  • Documents can not be intercepted.

 

An incoming DID can be assigned to a PCIFAX® fax delivery method ensuring protection of sensitive incoming credit card information and disabling access to the content by any interception method.

You can set this feature by adjusting the information on your fax number, you can find out how to here.

 

Sending from the Web interface.

The user specifies fax type as “PCI Fax”. Instead of indicating a recipient’s number, user must specify recipient’s email address.

 

Sending from your email client.

In order to send a PCIFax® via email, please input the email of the recipient in the following format:

In the “To:” field, put the destination email address but replace the “@“ for a “+” symbol followed by “@pcifax.ecomfax.com” (to send without a cover page) or “@pcifaxp.ecomfax.com” (to send with a cover page.)  For instance:

Peter.drove+company.com@pcifax.ecomfax.com

or

Peter.drove+company.com@pcifaxp.ecomfax.com

 

Start the SUBJECT with the PIN Code and then write the subject. The subject will be included on the cover notes. Do not leave a blank space between the PIN and the first word of the subject. (please note that PIN code is not needed in case of DKIM validation or if you are in the Enterprise subscription).

 

Receiving Incoming faxes using PCIFax®

One may assign a DID to receive faxes via PCIFAX®. There may be several reasons to use PCIFAX® as a receiving method instead of email delivery. For instance, one may not want email administrator or ISP to access the content or to intercept fax messages or one just wants to ensure attachments are not delivered to their email server.

By delivering incoming faxes through PCIFAX®, the email of an incoming fax only contains a link and not the attachment itself. In order to access the document, user has to be logged in to the eComFax webpage and once logged in he may visualize the content using a secure HTTPs connection.

articles.title: eComFax SMS and how to send one
articles.body_html:
eComFax® is a communications platform in which the fax is the main sending method but not the only one.

Through the ease of SMS, eComFax® enables users to send messages to mobile SMS with the convenience of a desktop or email client; as with other types of messages sent via eComFax®.

From the website, once logged in, the user should choose SMS and indicate the addressee’s telephone number (including "+" at the start always and the country code if international) and write the message. If the message is over 160 characters, the system will send the remaining characters in a separate message.

 

 

Using an email client, the user should write the addressee’s telephone number (including "+" at the start always and the country code if international) followed by “@sms.ecomfax.com” and in the subject field indicate own security PIN code, followed by the text to-be-sent. The body of the message will be ignored.

articles.title: eComFax CertiSMS® and how to send one
articles.body_html:
Why eComFax CertiSMS®

As with Fax, some companies need a proof that an SMS message has been sent without any doubt. Consequently, they may use that proof in a legal process with the guarantee that the communication occurred at a specific date and time, that the content was a specific one (as a proof of authenticity), that the communication occurred between two addresses, and that an independent third party guarantees that this indeed happened.

This is the aim of CertiSMS®. So, when an SMS is sent using this method, the information about the sender, recipient(s), content and SMS metadata are digitally signed using a CA (Certification Authority) with a Digital Time Stamp (issued by a legal TSA) and a PDF certificate is issued to the sender with all – above-noted – information concerning authenticity what can subsequently be used in a possible legal process.

The certificate is issued by CWS as a 3rd party trust processor to certify that the content (as it is shown in the certificate) was sent from the number of the sender and addressed to the destination at that date and time. This can be used in a law process to ensure the authenticity of the content, the legitimacy of the sender and the date and time it was communicated. Delivery Certificates are securely kept on the platform for a period of 5 years.

 

Sending from your email

CertiSMS® can be used from any client email. The text in the “subject” field will be sent as text, minimizing any attachment or text in the body of the message.

Recipients mobile telephone number is placed, followed by “@certisms.ecomfax.com”. In the “Subject” field security PIN code should be placed, followed by the text that to-be-sent. The body of the text will be ignored. Please note that in case of DKIM validation, PIN code is not necessary.

 

 

Tip; CertiSMS® can only be sent via an email and not through the web interface.

articles.title: Subscription
articles.body_html:
The first option to choose from is “Subscription” in which you can find your company’s contact information.

 

Tip: the email address here is solely for contact purposes only and is not used for sending or receiving faxes. 

 

Keeping this section updated is important so the team at eComFax has the correct information if we need to get in touch with you.

Clicking on “Save” at the bottom of the page will save any changes made in the “Configuration” menu.

articles.title: Delivery
articles.body_html:
Here are all the options available in the delivery section.

 

 

Email: This is where you allocate additional email addresses (or domains for Enterprise subscriptions) that you authorize to be secure senders of faxes from their email client for this account. You can have a maximum of three additional ones. The email registered here will both send and receive

To add a new one simply press the "+" button and use the "-" button to remove any later. However, the primary email can not be removed and needs to be changed by the support team or your Marketplace provider.

PIN: A PIN Code is a 4-digit number that must be placed at the very beginning of the “Subject field” when sending fax via the Email interface. This is used for security purposes. Please do not leave a blank space between the PIN and the SUBJECT field.

Note: In case DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM) validation technique is used, PIN entry is not needed. DKIM is an email authentication method designed to detect forged sender addresses in emails (email spoofing), a technique often used in phishing and email spam. It is specific to email provider; some may have this technique implemented while some not (eg. Microsoft Office 365 has DKIM built-in).

Customized fax number: A unique number that will appear on the cover page of all faxes.

Language: Indicates the default language of the notification messages and platform access.

Time Zone: eComFax® is a worldwide service, so the time zone may be adjusted in this field so as to receive the faxes at the date and time relevant to the user’s location.

Dialing code: For national calls, it is unusual to include the country code. As eComFax® only uses international numbers, the deliveries to its country are completed correctly with this option. As a result, the user may add the country code here, so that the system will deliver it correctly.

 

Storage and safekeeping.

30-day Free of Charge storage is included by default in any subscription; however, the user may want to keep fax or other documents for more than 30 days.

Users can increase the retention period by accessing the “Custody Period” Field. Note that HIPAA, Dodd-Frank Act, or MiFID II regulations (among others) may require companies to keep document records for at least 5 years.

Note: Changing the custody period will only take effect on new faxes after the change has been saved and previous faxes will need to have the custody manually changed via the message list.

 

Tip: Only faxes are stored, not SMS.

Custody Period: Here you choose the type of fax that should be stored, incoming, outgoing or all.

Secure Access Period:  This stipulates how long an access link in emails is valid.

articles.title: Notifications
articles.body_html:
The Notifications’ Subject of the incoming and outgoing faxes can be configured In the “Notifications” section. This allows viewing of the sender or the incoming faxes in the email list without having to open the message. This may also be used to format the message so it can be automatically used by a robot (CRM or Call Centre App) for categorization.

 

 

 

Fax Subject for Outbound Faxes: this field is used to personalize the subject of outgoing faxes.

 

Your options here are:

  • %1: Unique ID - This is the ID of the fax itself.
  • %2: To Fax Number - The fax number you are sending to.
  • %3: To Name - The name of the person you are sending to.
  • %4: Billing Code #1
  • %5: Billing Code #2
  • %6: TxTime - The time in minutes and seconds it took to send the fax.
  • %7: Owner - The email of the sender.
  • %8: Status - The end status of the fax itself.
  • %9: Result - The result of the transmission.
  • %0: Subject - Any text accompanying the transmission.

 

Fax Subject for Inbound faxes: this field is used to personalize the subject of incoming faxes.

 

Your options here are:

  • %1: Id - The remote-id of the sender.
  • %2: ANI - The number the fax came from.
  • %3: CSID - "Called Subscriber Identification" used on specific fax machines.
  • %4: DID - "Direct Inbound Dial" This is the fax number it was sent to, 
  • %5: Pages - Amount of pages including any cover notes.
  • %6: RxTime - The time in minutes and seconds it took to send the fax.
  • %7: Owner - The sender of the fax.

Tip: Traditional fax machines may not hold all this information.

 

SMS notifications permit reporting the balance in your account and the receiving and sending of a fax. You should add a telephone number with the “+” symbol, followed by the international country code.

SMS Subject: This field is used to personalize the subject of SMS notifications. eComFax® permits SMS notifications reporting the balance of the user’s account (for instance, a reminder when the user has only 20% of available credits left) and when receiving and sending a fax. A telephone number should be added with the “+” symbol, followed by the international country code.

 

Your options here are:

  • %1: Unique ID - This is the ID of the message itself.
  • %2: To Mobile Number - The destination mobile number
  • %3: To Name - The name of the person you are sending to.
  • %4: Billing Code #1
  • %5: Billing Code #2
  • %6: TxTime - The time in minutes and seconds it took to send the transmission.
  • %7: Owner - The sender of the fax.
  • %8: Status - The end status of the fax itself.
  • %9: Result - The result of the transmission.
  • %0: Message - The message itself.

 

When the user has consumed 80% of available credits, they will receive a notification email. There is the possibility of receiving an SMS notification as well (mentioned above). Sending these SMS notifications will consume credits (1.5 credits per notification).

When the user sends a Fax and does not have sufficient credits, the service will cover the full transmission cost; however, the credits due will be paid when the user purchases additional credit packs.

When the user wishes to receive a Fax and does not have sufficient credits, the platform will not resend the image of the fax via email to the user. Instead, a notification message will be sent informing them about an incoming fax document. eComFax® platform will retain the document for a maximum period of 30 days or when the user regains sufficient credit.

 

Tip: You can add credit packs to your account via your Marketplace or the Subscription section.

The user can select when the next report is to be sent, and how often reports will be sent in days and months. 

Then simply choose the type, format, recipient and language. Once configurated, select "OK"

The user can create multiple reports and modify reports from the report list.

articles.title: How do I login to eComfax? I can not login to eComFax!
articles.body_html:
There are two ways to access the eComFax platform and they depend on the way you purchased eComFax.

 

Purchased through a Telecommunications Marketplace that offers Single-Sign-On (SSO).

If you purchased eComFax through a Marketplace offered by your telecommunications provider, you will need to log into your relevant marketplace solution that you purchased eComFax through. Find the area where your eComFax application is stored and select to login. 

 

Tip: If you do not know your credentials for your relevant marketplace, contact that marketplace or use their specific password recovery process!

 

The credentials you used to access that specific marketplace will be enough to log into eComFax without any other credentials.

 

Tip: If the eComFax icon does not appear in your marketplace or the link does not direct you correctly to eComFax, please contact your relevant marketplace helpdesk who will guide you through the process!

 

Purchased directly through eComFax or an Enterprise customer.

If you purchased eComFax directly or you are an Enterprise customer, you can access eComFax directly through the URL: https://www.ecomfax.com/user/ using the username and password provided to you upon subscription.

If you do not remember the credentials to access the platform you can use the password recovery process, by selecting "Forgot your password?"

Any further issues, you can open a support ticket from the main help page and a representative from eComFax will be in touch to help you.

When your fax service is enabled, you will be assigned a local number in the city you have selected, which will be your personal fax number from that moment. You can see in the home page your assigned fax number in the eComFax user portal.

The faxes that you receive in your number will be forwarded to the e-mail account (s) that you have configured (from the "Configuration-Delivery" menu in ecomfax) as an attachment.

articles.title: If I request the portability of my fax number, will I ever be without a line?
articles.body_html:
There are two temporary windows in portability, the Administrative and the Window of change. During the Administrative window, which is usually the most extensive, between 7 and 15 days, you continue using your line normally.


During the Change Window, technical procedures are executed to change operator, and these can cause the line to be unavailable, for a short period of time, which should not exceed a few hours.

Normally the Window of change is made in a low or no activity schedule and probably you will not appreciate it. The only symptom is that once the change is finished, you will start receiving faxes in your eComFax service.

articles.title: I have a shared fax and voice line. What should I do?
articles.body_html: You are receiving voice and fax calls on the same number and line, you may have a discriminator or simply manually activate the fax when it detects a certain special fax sound on the call. In this case we recommend contracting the fax service with new numbering. The new number will be your private fax number that you must add in your advertising and business cards.

articles.title: Can I change my fax number?
articles.body_html: No. To change the fax number, for example, because you want to have a fax number corresponding to another province, you must request a service registration for the new number, and once you do so, cancel the number you no longer want.

articles.title: How do I know that the procedure to keep my number has been successful? that the portability was correct
articles.body_html:
During the processing process, you will see that the status of your Fax number is "pending".

Until such portability processing is not effective, you can only "send faxes" from eComFax, the reception will continue without variation in your old device until the portability is completed.

When the portability has finished correctly, automatically, the status of your Fax goes to OK and therefore you will start receiving your faxes in eComFax and you can use the service to send and receive faxes.

From that moment you can unsubscribe your old line if you wish and you only need to use eComFax to send and receive faxes.

articles.title: How long does it take to manage portability?
articles.body_html: The time to complete the change of operator is 7 to 15 working days from receipt of the signed request of the user along with the necessary documents. Processing will not start until we receive all the necessary documentation.

articles.title: Can I request the withdrawal of the line before terminating portability to eComFax?
articles.body_html: NO, you can not request the cancellation of the line up to 15 days after completing portability to eComFax. You can see the status within the user's web menu

articles.title: What is portability?
articles.body_html: It involves changing the operator, keeping the same fax number.

articles.title: Can I keep my fax number?
articles.body_html: Yes, carrying out the portability correctly. You can know more in deep about portability process in the Technical note about Portability in this website.

articles.title: Why can I not send more than 10MB?
articles.body_html:
Fax is a delicate process and needs to take several factors into account. One such factor is the size of the document that is being sent.

Sending large files can be problematic, here are a few reasons why:

 

1. To send a fax requires a connection between two devices and can still be easily broken, large faxes require a much longer transmission time for the data to be sent from one end to another, opening up the risk to failed transmissions,

2. Having documents with large or high-resolution images also takes time as we need to convert the overall fax into a PCL image for traditional fax machines to be able to receive and print.

3. Website performance can be affected by uploading large files or images, so reducing the amount that can be upload improves response times.

 

This is why we introduced the limitation of 10MB, this helps ensure the safe sending of your documents, with as little interruption as possible (When sending to traditional fax machines, there are always potential risks of interruption).

 

You can still send multiple documents via email or the web platform with eComFax, providing the document's total size does not exceed 10MB.

 

What can you do?

If your document(s) exceeds this size here are some ideas to help:

1. Try to send in smaller quantities, this helps ensure a smoother and faster transmission.

2. If it is not possible to separate, i.e. one document, try to either reduce the image quality or in fact remove any unnecessary images at all from the file.

3. Try to change the file type of the document, for example, rich text documents are heavier than standard word documents.

3. If your email server allows the sending of files over 10MB, then you can use the email service. However, keep in mind a transmission still needs to be maintained while sending, (Most email service providers, do limit the amount of data that can be sent via email).

articles.title: Can I send a document different to DIN A4?
articles.body_html: No. The fax format known worldwide is the DIN A4 format.

articles.title: I am getting an error when faxing.
articles.body_html:
Sending a fax is an easy process of adding in the fax number, choosing to add a cover note, attaching the document and clicking send! However, what happens when you get an error?

Errors can come from many different reasons, here are a few examples of why a fax did not send correctly:

Broken connection:

This is a common issue that normally stems from the fact the receiving fax is in fact not a fax line or not active, there are ways you can check this.

  • Try to call that fax number on your phone, if you hear a standard dial tone and not fax tone (sounds like a traditional modem sound) then that number is not a fax line.
  • Reach out to the person you are trying to fax to get them to confirm the number is working ok or not.

Finally a broken connection can also mean the number you are faxing may not be correct, so please double check and try again.

Busy Line:

A busy line means that the person you are trying to fax is in fact busy, eComFax will accept faxes at anytime. However, individuals using traditional fax machines do not have that same luxury. eComFax will attempt to send the fax on multiple occasions to the number at different intervals within a set time frame to ensure as best as possible that the fax can be sent.

The error simply means we exhausted the amount of attempts to reach that number.

Conversion error:

This happens when the fax you are attempting to send can not be converted into a fax image, this is common with password protected documents that cannot be sent via eComFax.

Email specific errors:

A common error will happen when a fax is trying to be sent from an email address that is not authorised to send faxes.

If you receive this type of error (that normally is a return email from your provider) log into the platform, head to <Configuration> then <Delivery> and make sure that your email address is listed at the top, or you email domain (Enterprise subscriptions) is listed. If not add the email address (using the "+") button and try again.

Tip: You can have up to 3 authorised sending email addresses and domains (Enterprise subscription) and you can edit them at any point.

Pin was not used:

For SOHO and SMB subscriptions and email clients that do not use DKIM the pin number will need to be used when sending faxes from your email client. You can find your pin on the platform under <Configuration> then <Delivery>. The pin must be used in the subject field before any text that is to be shown to the recipient.

Tip: The pin will not be seen by the recipient at all and it can also be changed at any point!

 

Anything else that does not appear to be working, please open a support ticket on the main help page.

articles.title: I am not receiving my faxes into my email, what do I do?
articles.body_html:
If you are not receiving your faxes into your email account, the first thing to do is to log onto the web platform and check the message list to ensure you are still receiving your faxes. If your faxes are not showing please open a support ticket on the main help page.

 

If your faxes appear in the message list then the service is still working fine. The you need to check your email client, common issues are the spam folder and any redirections, also check the email address is correct and is not full.

 

Alternatively you can make sure our email domains are not being restricted by your email by ensuring they are whitelisted. Make sure the following domains are added to the white list:

  • @ecomfax.com
  • @amazonses.com

Alternatively, you can add additional email address or email domains (enterprise subscriptions) to your account. Simply log into the platform select <Configuration> then <Delivery> and add them at the top using the "+" button. You can add up to three additional ones.

Once these steps are followed, yet emails are still not coming through please open a support ticket on the main help page explaining the steps you have taken.

articles.title: When I send a fax from my email account what are the types of supported files?
articles.body_html:
The web allows you to send attachments with the following formats: Microsoft Office, txt, pdf, tif, jpeg, html, png, and many others.

If the format is not recognized an error occurs and you will be notified.

articles.title: What if I send a fax without an attachment or a cover note?
articles.body_html: If you send a fax without an attachment and without a cover, it will be an error since there is nothing to send.

articles.title: How do I know that I am running out of credits?
articles.body_html:
You will receive a notification email when you have consumed 80% of your balance. There is the possibility of receiving a “notification by SMS”. This notification is activated from the section “Configuration" option on the User’s Web. The sending of these notifications by SMS consume credits.

 

My subscription plan includes some pages of sending and receiving faxes. What happens if I do not have enough credits to receive faxes?

Faxes are received but will not be delivered until you top up with the necessary credits.

 

When you want to receive a Fax and you do not have enough credits to do so in your subscription, it will take them from your sending credits. eComFax will save the faxes up to a maximum of 30 days.

 

When sending a fax you receive a notification saying that the fax could not be sent due to insufficient balance.

This occurs because you do not have a sufficient balance and you would have to top up the balance or wait until the end of the month so that your subscription is renewed automatically and you are assigned new credits.

articles.title: What happens if my account balance runs out?
articles.body_html: Each month we give new credits according to the contracted plan. These credits do not accumulate from one month to the next. If you need more credits for a specific month, you can top up your balance by clicking “Reload” in the “Start” menu of the eComFax user website or by using your Marketplace specific sales agent. This credit needs to be consumed within a year.

articles.title: How to cancel your eComFax service.
articles.body_html:
We are sorry to hear if you wish to cancel your service and appreciate any feedback from your time with us which you can send to customer.services@ecomfax.com.

 

The way to cancel your service depends on the way you subscribed eComFax in the first place.

 

If you subscribed through a Marketplace such as AppDirect or similar, you cancel you subscription from your account page.

 

If you purchased eComFax directly you will need to inform your eComFax sales agent who will arrange this for you.

articles.title: Will I lose my fax number when I cancel the service?
articles.body_html: Yes. If you wish to keep the fax number you must request to port the fax number to your new operator before cancelling the service.

articles.title: How do I manage outgoing eComFax porting?
articles.body_html: You should contact your new operator and follow the procedures indicated by your new provider. There is no cost by eComFax.

articles.title: Will I lose my account balance or top up by cancelling the service?
articles.body_html: Yes, the cancellation of the subscription implies the loss of the Balance or top up although you may continue to use the service until the end of your current subscription period.

articles.title: Dificultades en el envío y recepción de faxes
articles.body_html: Si experimentas dificultades al enviar o recibir faxes, describe el caso mediante el formulario de soporte. Incluye fecha, número de origen y destino, mensaje de error y, si es posible, una captura.

articles.title: Problems sending or receiving faxes
articles.body_html: If you have trouble sending or receiving faxes, describe the case in the support form. Include the date, source and destination numbers, error message and, if possible, a screenshot.

articles.title: Doble factor de autenticación
articles.body_html:
Recordia da la posibilidad de configurar el doble factor de autenticación para un inicio de sesión más seguro. De esta manera, al iniciar sesión en el grabador en red se prueba la identidad del usuario y se garantiza el acceso seguro.
La autenticación múltiple introduce una segunda clave además de la contraseña previamente introducida. La clave puede ser otorgada mediante dos vías diferentes: sms o totp/hotp.

Vía TOTP 
Para realizar el doble factor de autenticación vía TOTP, se deberá iniciar sesión en la plataforma.

Recordia - Iniciar sesión


Una vez iniciada la sesión, aparecerá un código QR que deberá ser escaneado a través de una aplicación móvil de autenticación TOTP como puede ser Google Authenticator.

El escaneo de este código QR con el móvil vinculará el dispositivo con la cuenta de Recordia de manera que en futuros inicios de sesión se generará un código a introducir en el aplicativo de Recordia. El código generado tendrá una validez temporal y se renovará automáticamente. 

 

En caso de que requiera de que se le active la doble autenticación o tenga problemas a la hora de autenticarse, deberá abrir un ticket a nuestro soporte facilitando la información de usuario para poder revisar su cuenta en Recordia.

articles.title: ¿Cómo registrarse en Recordia?
articles.body_html:
El registro de un nuevo usuario se lleva a cabo de dos formas diferentes:

  • Si se ha contratado el servicio a través de Comunycarse, entonces será Comunycarse el responsable de realizar el registro del nuevo cliente.
  • Si se ha contratado el servicio a través de Telefónica, entonces será Telefónica el responsable de realizar el registro del nuevo cliente.

Por último, las credenciales de acceso le serán facilitadas al cliente final, que deberá realizar un cambio de contraseña por motivos de seguridad.

Podrá acceder a su servicio de Recordia siguiendo las instrucciones de este enlace

Si no le han suministrado unas credenciales válidas, póngase en contacto con su proveedor.

articles.title: Acceso al Servicio
articles.body_html:
1. Acceso al Servicio

Para acceder al servicio de Grabación en Red, deberemos hacerlo a través de un navegador Web.

Al tratarse de una Interfaz Responsive, permite el acceso desde cualquier dispositivo, ya sea de escritorio o móvil, lo que le facilita la accesibilidad desde distintos dispositivos y experiencia del usuario.

 

2. Login

Desde la página de inicio pulse la opción entrar. Acto seguido introduzca sus credenciales de usuario y contraseña, así como el idioma elegido, actualmente disponible en castellano, catalán e inglés.

 

Pantalla de Inicio

articles.title: Recuperación de contraseña
articles.body_html:
En el caso de que olvide la contraseña, podrá recuperarla accediendo a través de la opción ¿Olvidó la contraseña?  donde introducirá el usuario para recibir un correo que permita restaurar las credenciales de la cuenta.

 

Detalle Opción de Recuperación de Contraseña

articles.title: Menú de opciones
articles.body_html:
Al acceder a Recordia por defecto lo hará en la página de inicio donde dispondrá de una serie de estadísticas sobre el servicio y su uso.

En el menú superior tendrá acceso a las siguientes opciones que variarán en base a las diferentes funcionalidades contratadas:

 

Detalle de Acceso a los diferentes módulos del Recordia

 

  1. Dashboard: Es la interfaz principal del usuario, en esta interfaz se recoge un resumen del usuario y la información más relevante de las llamadas. Además, si se pulsa sobre dashboard, se pueden ver submenús general, categorías y calidad, con información más detallada de estos campos.
  2. Interacciones: En esta interfaz se muestran las grabaciones por defecto de la última semana. Aquí podremos filtrar por diversos criterios de búsqueda las grabaciones objeto de nuestro interés y acceder a otras operaciones como la reproducción, el historial y la descarga en función de nuestros privilegios.
  3. Categorías: Aquí se encuentra una clasificación de casos o categorías en las que se clasifican las llamadas. Podrá filtrar por tema (asunto), fecha y propietario o autorizados de manera que detectará los casos más comunes en el periodo seleccionado.
  4. Calidad: desde esta interfaz el usuario podrá programar las reglas o palabras a partir de las cuáles se clasificarán las llamadas por caso. Estas reglas podrán ser configuradas tanto en función del canal como del idioma y serán personalizadas para cada corporativo.
  5. Prueba de audio: Una pequeña prueba de audio para verificar el correcto volumen del ordenador para la escucha de las llamadas.
  6. Informes: en esta pantalla se podrá configurar informes automáticos que se generarán en la plataforma tanto la lista de grabaciones, como el listado de usuarios, extensiones o grupos y el historial de usuarios. Estos informes autogenerados serán enviados en el periodo de tiempo y al contacto fijado por el usuario.
  7. Usuarios: El entorno de Usuarios lista el árbol de usuarios, números y extensiones, organizados jerárquicamente. En función de los permisos se podrá administrar dando de alta grupos, usuarios y permitiendo la asociación de números y/o extensiones.
  8. Umbrales de analítica: en esta pantalla se configuran los parámetros de solapamiento máximo de llamada, porcentaje de silencios máximo y la nota mínima para el aprobado de calidad.
  9. Perfil de usuario: En esta opción están disponibles las opciones de Manual de usuario, Cerrar Sesión y Mi Perfil donde podrá acceder a la Información Personal y Cambio de Contraseña.
  10. Notificaciones: (Campana) Acceso en el que se listan y presentan notificaciones del sistema.

articles.title: Inicio (Estadísticas)
articles.body_html:
1. Inicio (Estadísticas)

El módulo de Estadísticas ofrece información actualizada y visual sobre la evolución e información relativa al número de llamadas, el tiempo grabado acumulado diariamente y el ranking de usuarios más activos dentro del servicio.

 

Vista General de Inicio Estadísticas

 

En el Panel de Control encontrará dos bloques referentes al número total de grabaciones acumulado para el rango de fecha establecido, por defecto de una diariamente y el tiempo grabado total acumulado.

 

2. Filtrar por fecha

Haciendo clic en el rango de fechas de la esquina superior derecha del Panel de Control, podrá seleccionar el rango de fechas que quiere representar en los gráficos de la interfaz principal.

 

Detalle de Filtro por Fechas para Estadísticas

 

Dispondrá de un conjunto de filtros por defecto para el día en curso, ayer y los 7 o 30 días pasados entre otros. No obstante, si lo requiere, podrá acotar la búsqueda en función de sus necesidades.

 

3. Descarga de informes

Si pulsa el icono de descarga,  accesible en la parte superior del Panel de Control, podrá descargar los informes tanto en formato CSV como en formato PDF.

 

Detalle de Descarga de Informes de Estadísticas

Vista de Informe de Estadísticas en formato PDF

articles.title: Interacciones, listado y búsqueda
articles.body_html:
En la interfaz de grabaciones dispondrá del listado de las grabaciones existentes en el sistema.

Por defecto el Recordia, lista las grabaciones de los últimos siete días, pero existen una serie de filtros para facilitar la recuperación de las grabaciones en función de nuestras necesidades.

 

Pantalla Principal Grabaciones

 

También podrá navegar por las diferentes páginas de resultados, así como decidir el número de registros que quiere visualizar en la pantalla.

 

Detalle de Filtros de Visualización en Grabaciones

articles.title: Filtros de búsqueda
articles.body_html:
Recordia permite filtrar los registros a través de las siguientes opciones:

 

Detalle de Filtros de Búsqueda en Grabaciones

 

  1. Fecha: Permite filtrar por rango de fechas año, mes y día.
  2. Duración de la Grabación: Esta opción permite acotar la duración de la llamada entre un mínimo y un máximo
  3. Extensión: Podrá filtrar por la extensión que necesite.
  4. Nombre: Introduciendo el número de la extensión, podrá acotar los resultados por dicho criterio.
  5. Tipo: Esta opción permite filtrar por diversas opciones Todas las llamadas, Fijos, Móviles y SMSs
  6. Números de contacto: Seleccionar los registros que cumplan con un número del interlocutor determinado.
  7. Acciones: Botones de acción de Buscar o Limpiar. Esta última para limpiar el contenido de los criterios de búsqueda.
  8. Informes: Acción que permite la descarga de la información de los registros tanto en formato CSV o PDF

Además, podrá organizar de manera ascendente o descendente los resultados por el criterio seleccionado. Para ello, y desde el encabezado de la columna que le interese, pulse el icono

articles.title: Búsquedas por campos Identificador  único de la grabación y campo Notas
articles.body_html:
Recordia permite filtrar los resultados por otros criterios no mostrados en la tabla de forma directa, como puedan ser el Identificador único de la grabación, el campo Notas o incluso, por palabras de la transcripción.

 

 

Para ello desde el botón de búsqueda, deberá pinchar en la flecha del extremo de manera que se muestre una ventana de búsqueda emergente desde la que desplegar el criterio por el que quiere buscar.

 

Detalle de ventana de búsqueda Identificador y Notas.

articles.title: Gestión de Registros Grabados
articles.body_html:
Recordia permite las siguientes acciones sobre un registro de grabación existente en el sistema. El tercer icono, el de transcripción, únicamente estará visible para los clientes que así lo tengan contratado.

 

Detalle de Vista de Grabaciones

articles.title: Reproducir
articles.body_html:
Pulsando sobre el icono podrá reproducir el archivo de audio. Cada interacción que hagan con cualquiera de los registros del sistema, se registrará en el historial de dicho archivo con el fin de disponer de trazabilidad y auditoría sobre la grabación.

 

Detalle de Vista de Grabaciones. Icono Reproducir

 

Recordia cuenta con dos tipos de reproductores: reproductor sencillo y reproductor avanzado entre los cuales se cambia dando al botón derecho [cambiar a reproductor avanzado o cambiar a reproductor simple].

 

Detalle Vista de Reproductor simple

 

Respecto al reproductor avanzado permite ver las ondas de sonido por lo que de un solo vistazo se pude identificar las partes en las que hay algún tipo de conversación. Por otro lado, cuando se tiene contratado el transcriptor verá la transcripción al tiempo que se hace la escucha, así como si se trata de una intervención de un agente o cliente y la palabra de la traducción en la que está.

 

Detalle Vista de Reproductor simple

articles.title: Descargar
articles.body_html:
Recordia permite descargar un archivo o varios archivos simultáneamente. Si desea descargar varios archivos, habrá que seleccionar todos aquellos registros objeto de nuestro interés, marcando las casillas correspondientes. Al proceder a la descarga pulsando el icono se generará un archivo Zip que contendrá todas las grabaciones seleccionadas.

 

Detalle de Vista de Descarga de Grabaciones

 

El nombre de los ficheros descargados tiene la siguiente nomenclatura:


Grabación_aaaammddhhmmss_Número_Llamante_Número_Llamado_GUID1.

 

Detalle de Vista de Grabación Descargada

 

1- : AAMMDDHHMMSS Año, Mes, día, Hora, Minutos y Segundos
2- : Número Llamante
3- : Número Llamado

articles.title: Transcriptor
articles.body_html:
Recordia también permite, si tiene contratada la licencia de transcripción, entonces podrá consultar no sólo el audio de la grabación sino también la transcripción en texto de la misma separados por dos canales.


Para consultar las transcripciones tendrá que hacer click en el botón Transcribir y aparecerá una ventana emergente donde aparecerá el idioma desde el que se ha realizado la transcripción y el texto separados por interlocutores.


Para una transcripción óptima deberá indicarse el idioma en el que está hecha la grabación, que podrá variarse del que le configuramos en Recordia por defecto siempre que sea necesario.

 

El texto de la transcripción podrá ser copiado en el portapapeles y pegado en cualquier documento.

 

Detalle de ventana emergente de transcripción

articles.title: Detalles de la Grabación
articles.body_html:
En los detalles de la grabación accederá a la información e historial de ese registro. Para ello pulse el icono .

 

Detalle de Vista Detalles de la Grabación

 

 


Puede encontrar el caso de que a la hora de consultar una llamada vea que hay un icono con forma de reloj de arena. Esto significa que se ha recibido el registro de la llamada en Recordia, pero todavía no está disponible el contenido de la grabación.


Este estado normalmente es transitorio, por ejemplo, si el tamaño de la grabación es muy grande. Si persiste esta condición es indicativo de que ha habido algún problema en la subida de la grabación por lo que habría que abrir una incidencia.

 

Detalle de Registro de Grabación en Curso

 

 

En los detalles de la grabación se muestran los números que han intervenido en la llamada, así como la fecha de la grabación. Además, existe un campo comentarios en el cual los usuarios podrán incluir anotaciones asociadas a dicha grabación.

 

Además, se puede consultar información relativa al HASH de la grabación, además hay un campo denominado Identificador para soporte técnico. Este campo será de utilidad en el caso de que necesite reportar algún tipo de incidente relacionado con esa grabación.

 

Detalle Vista Avanzada de Detalles de la Grabación

 

Si necesita verificar la integridad y autenticidad de una grabación, podrá hacerlo a través de la opción Verificar. articles.title: Categorías
articles.body_html:
En esta parte de la plataforma el usuario podrá ver la clasificación de las llamadas por temas o categorías. Recordia a través del Key Word Spotting permite clasificar las llamadas por casos, así como descargar los informes de los casos en CSV.

 

Pantalla de categorías

 

En esta primera tabla general se podrán consultar las categorías creadas así como la fecha de creación, el propietario – es decir, quién creo la categoría-, los autorizados y el número de interacciones guardadas bajo esta etiqueta.


Si considera que alguna categoría ya no le resulta de utilidad puede eliminar el caso a través del botón de eliminar , acción que no supondrá la eliminación de las interacciones sino únicamente de la etiqueta bajo la cual están clasificadas.

articles.title: Ampliar la información de una categoría
articles.body_html:
Además de la información disponible en la tabla podrá acceder a una información más amplia a través del botón Detalles . Al pinchar en ese botón se abrirá una nueva pantalla en la que se podrá consultar además de la información previa el ID por el que se identifica cada categoría así como la información relacionada con cada una de las interacciones clasificadas bajo éste.

 

Información detallada de cada caso

 

En la parte de la izquierda de la pantalla se podrá consultar la información de las interacciones que serán:


• Fecha de realización
• Tipo de llamada: si se trata de una llamada entrante o saliente.
• Origen: número de teléfono o extensión de origen
• Acciones: Las interacciones será posible no sólo escucharlas en streaming sin
necesidad de descarga, sino también moverla de caso, es decir, cambiarle la
etiqueta o eliminarla.


Dentro de cada caso dispondrá de un historial de accesos desde el que se podrá hacer un seguimiento de las diferentes interacciones realizadas, como puede ser la descarga de información, su creación o la clasificación de alguna interacción nueva. Tanto las interacciones como este historial podrán ser descargadas en ZIP en el caso de las primeras y CSV o PDF en el caso de las segundas que deberá elegir en la ventana modal que aparecerá una vez seleccionado descargar el historial.

 

                               

Desplegable de acciones y modal de opción de descarga

 

Por otro lado, será posible realizar una búsqueda filtrada tanto de las interacciones clasificadas dentro de una categoría como de los casos en la pantalla exterior de manera que su consulta sea más eficiente.

articles.title: Descargar informes
articles.body_html:

Podrá acceder a los informes a través del botón de la esquina superior izquierda en la ventana de casos . Al accionar este botón saldrá un desplegable en el que se da la opción de descargar el informe en CVS, un archivo compatible con programas estándar como Excel.

 

Submenú para exportar informes a CSV

 

Previo a la exportación de CSV deberá seleccionar en la tabla el o los casos que desea descargar. Se descargará un archivo .ZIP con dos archivos CSV en su interior: los metadatos de las interacciones bajo el nombre Interacciones y los metadatos del caso bajo el nombre Metadatos.

articles.title: Crear una nueva categoría
articles.body_html:
Cada empresa o corporativo podrá crear nuevas categorías para que sus interacciones sean clasificadas de acuerdo con los intereses corporativos. El usuario administrador tendrá la capacidad de crear estas nuevas categorías únicamente pulsando sobre el botón crear nueva categoría.

 

 

Una vez accionado el botón se abrirá una pantalla igual a la que amplia información en el caso de una categoría creada pero con los campos vacíos y sin interacción salvada bajo este nombre como se verá a continuación:

 

Crear un nuevo caso

 

Cada categoría quedará identificada por un ID único que minimizará las equivocaciones en el etiquetado por coincidencia de nombres entre categorías. Es decir, es posible que existan dos categorías con el mismo nombre pero cada uno estará identificado por un ID por lo que no se mezclarán a la hora de clasificar las interacciones. A la hora de crear una nueva categoría, el único dato que habrá que modificar será el Asunto, es decir, el nombre por el que el usuario identificará el caso como puede ser: hipotecas o atención al cliente.

 

Metadatos del nuevo caso

 

Para consultar esta nueva categoría, únicamente podrá un usuario con permisos como un Administrador o aquellos autorizados. Para incluir nuevos usuarios autorizados deberá pinchar en el botón administrar y aparecerá un modal con los usuarios registrados en Recordia. De esta manera podrá seleccionar aquellos usuarios que desee.

Una vez creada la categoría, será necesario que se creen las reglas como se explicarán en el siguiente punto de este documento para que puedan clasificarse las llamadas en este caso a partir de las Key Word establecidas (podrá contar con la ayuda de Comunycarse para elegir las más óptimas en función del servicio que ofrezca).

articles.title: Reglas
articles.body_html:
En la ventana de Reglas podemos encontrar a su vez dos secciones: palabras clave y eventos automáticos. Por Palabras clave o Key Word se entienden todas aquellas palabras o términos que, tras su detección en una interacción, clasificará la misma en función del caso que se le ha sido asignado. En el caso de los Eventos automáticos son una serie de reglas que desencadenan una acción, por ejemplo se puede dar el caso en el que un evento sea enviar un email cada vez que se etiquete una interacción bajo el caso Satisfacción negativa.

 

Desplegable de Reglas: Palabras clave y eventos automáticos

 

Una vez elegida una de las opciones se abrirá la siguiente pantalla donde a través de unas tabs podrá elegir si quiere consultar las palabras clave o los eventos automáticos.

articles.title: Palabras clave
articles.body_html:
En la sección de palabras clave se deberán introducir las palabras a partir de las cuales se van a clasificar las llamadas. Se trata del reconocimiento de palabras clave durante la llamada que determinen que una cierta interacción pertenezca a un caso u otro.


Esta es una de las partes más importantes ya que con una buena detección de palabras clave la clasificación será óptima.


En la tabla con las palabras clave tendrá los siguientes datos:

  • Palabra clave: es la palabra literal que se deberá pronunciar durante la conversación
  • Canal: determina quién deberá pronunciar la palabra clave para ser detectada si el agente interno o el interlocutor.
  • Momento de la llamada: indica el momento en el que debe de aparecer la palabra clave, puede ser al inicio de la llamada, llamada completa o final de la llamada.
  • Presencia: indica si debe aparecer esa palabra clave o no debe aparecer para una correcta clasificación de la categoría.
  • Idioma: la detección de palabras clave no funciona únicamente en castellano, sino también en inglés y catalán.
  • Acciones: las palabras clave podrán editarse y borrarse

Tabla de palabras clave

articles.body_html:
Existen dos tipos de eventos automáticos: eventos de etiquetado por casos y el evento como notificación.


Los primeros eventos automáticos es la funcionalidad que une el etiquetado de palabras clave con la clasificación de las interacciones por caso. Es decir, en los eventos automáticos se configura que las palabras clave que ha determinado previamente se clasifiquen por casos. De esta manera, si se tiene configurada como palabra clave: dar de baja y esa palabra clave se ha etiquetado como satisfacción negativa, para que las interacciones con esta etiqueta se clasifiquen bajo el caso Satisfacción negativa deberá configurar un evento automático que diga que esa etiqueta se guarde en el caso Satisfacción negativa como se puede ver a continuación:

articles.title: Exportación de grabaciones a sistemas de archivo externos
articles.body_html:
Recordia proporciona un alto nivel de seguridad al encriptar los objetos utilizando métodos de encriptación HSM con políticas de rotación que aseguran que la privacidad sea la mejor en la industria. Los objetos se cifran con algoritmos AES256 y las conexiones se realizan con protocolos seguros como IPSEC y HTTPS o con VPN y SDN. Además, ofrece capacidades de auditoría y registro para cualquier acceso a la plataforma, ya que las reglamentaciones solicitan la trazabilidad de cada documento al que se accede en la plataforma.


En Recordia, entendemos que se trata de Seguridad. Recordia ha invertido una gran cantidad de recursos humanos y la más alta tecnología en seguridad para mantener los datos seguros siguiendo los más altos estándares de la industria.


Recomendamos encarecidamente a nuestros clientes que mantengan los datos dentro de Recordia para que pueda tener trazabilidad de lo que se ha accedido. Para las finanzas y la protección de datos confidenciales, esto es crucial, ya que necesitamos asegurar al regulador que solo las personas a las que se les permite acceder a la información tienen acceso a la misma. Además, si está ejecutando aplicaciones de análisis de voz, como la transcripción, la traducción o la detección de palabras, le recomendamos que mantenga esta información en Recordia en lugar de proporcionar esta información a terceros, ya que tendrá que ir a los procedimientos de seguridad para garantizar que estos datos no caigan en manos no autorizadas.

 

Sin embargo, algunos clientes pueden querer tener una copia de los datos almacenados en Recordia solo para tener su copia o porque desean abandonar el servicio en algún momento. Por esta razón, se ha creado una funcionalidad para exportar interacciones a un sistema de archivo externo.

articles.title: Indicar una reccopilación
articles.body_html:
Antes de extraer la información de Recordia, deberá indicar una recopilación. Para ello únicamente deberá haber iniciado sesión y desplegar el menú de Configuraciones.

 

Configuración. Descargas FTP.

articles.title: Configure la descarga FTP.
articles.body_html:
Es posible que tenga requisitos específicos con respecto a la frecuencia que necesita para recopilar sus conjuntos de datos. Para ello debe configurar la descarga de ficheros donde podrá modificar los siguientes parámetros:

 

Seleccione la frecuencia de recopilación de datos.

 

  • Frecuencia: diaria o semanal.
  • Caducidad: nn días. Este es el número general de días asignados a la custodia.
  • Hora del día: esta es la hora del día en que se ejecutará la recopilación.
  • Día de la semana: cuando selecciona Semanalmente, esto le permitirá seleccionar el día de la semana para que se realice la recopilación.
  • Tipo de interacciones incluidos: Recordia no graba únicamente las interacciones por llamada, sino que también cuenta con un registro de otro tipo de interacciones como los SMS o incluso conferencias por Teams. A través de este menú podrá elegir que tipo de interacciones desea descargar.
  • Metadatos de fichero por separado: en el caso de querer guardar únicamente los metadatos de la grabación será posible una vez activada esta opción de manera que se descarguen dos ficheros por interacción: el archivo de audio y los metadatos.
  • Tamaño máximo de archivos: se podrá limitar el tamaño de archivo más grande para evitar descargas demasiado pesadas en su terminal.

articles.body_html:

articles.title: Acceder al conjunto de datos mediante  un cliente FTP
articles.body_html:
Puede acceder a los conjuntos de datos seguros mediante un método programático o mediante un cliente FTP seguro. Para hacerlo, deberá utilizar ftp contra la URL ftp.recordia.net.


Antes de poder acceder a logarse en el servidor de descarga deberá ponerse en contacto con CWS e indicar su IP o IPs públicas para crear una regla en el Firewall que permita responder a sus peticiones.


Una vez que haya hecho eso, se le solicitará un usuario y una contraseña. Deberá ingresar las credenciales del administrador principal o un usuario con una lista para acceso FTP habilitado.

 

Ingrese User/password para la descarga de las grabaciones.

 

Podrá ver un catálogo de conjuntos de datos seguros.

 

Vista del catálogo de conjuntos.

 

Seleccione uno de los conjuntos de datos, haga clic derecho y guárdelo en su disco duro o almacenamiento NAS.


Una vez que se haya descargado el conjunto de datos, puede echarle un vistazo al contenido o expandirlo. Tenga en cuenta que este es un archivo .ZIP estándar que puede extraer utilizando herramientas estándar.Si así lo ha seleccionado, en el conjunto de datos, encontrará dos tipos de archivos, los metadatos y los archivos multimedia. Puede abrir el archivo metadata.csv utilizando el software estándar de Excel. Las columnas contienen nombre, se explican por sí mismas y están delimitadas.

 

Ejemplo de contenido de un Zip en el que seven los .WAV y el Excel con los metadatos.

Puede usar estos datos para indexar o interconectarse con su propio CMS estándar.

articles.title: Acceder al conjunto de datos mediante  SFTP.
articles.body_html:
SFTP es, por seguridad, la opción recomendada para la descarga de sus grabaciones desde Recordia. Antes de poder hacer la descarga, tiene que ponerse en contacto con Comunycarse para configurar conjuntamente este acceso seguro. Será necesario que suministre:

  • Una clave pública generada por su organización para la autenticación en el servidor de descarga.
  • IPs públicas desde las que hará la descarga para poder abrir en el Firewall las peticiones procedentes de Ud.


Para el acceso al servidor SFTP se tiene que usar un cliente SFTP como Filezilla o WinSCP. Podrá acceder en la URL

  • Sftp://ftp.recordia.net/
  • Puerto: 22

articles.title: Acerca de Recordia
articles.body_html:

Los objetos se cifran mediante algoritmos AES256, y se realizan conexiones utilizando protocolos seguros como IPSEC y HTTPS o utilizando VPN y SDN. Además, proporcionamos capacidades de auditoría y registro para cualquier acceso a la plataforma, ya que la normativa solicita la trazabilidad de cada documento al que se accede dentro de ella.

Recordia ha invertido una gran cantidad de recursos humanos y la más alta tecnología en seguridad para mantener los datos seguros siguiendo los más altos estándares de la industria.

Recomendamos encarecidamente a nuestros clientes que mantengan los datos dentro de Recordia para que puedan tener trazabilidad sobre lo que se ha accedido. Para finanzas y datos confidenciales protección, esto es crucial, ya que necesitamos asegurar al regulador que la información es solo accedidoX por personas autorizadas.

Además, si está ejecutando aplicaciones como análisis de voz, transcripción, traducción o detección de palabras, le recomendamos que mantenga esta información en Recordia en lugar de proporcionar estos datos a terceros, ya que deberá acudir a los procedimientos de seguridad para asegurarse de que
estos datos no caen en manos no autorizadas.

articles.title: Administración de Usuarios
articles.body_html:

articles.title: How to register for Recordia?
articles.body_html:
The registration of a new user is carried out in two different ways:

  • If the service has been contracted through Cloud Worldwide Services, then Cloud Worldwide Services will be responsible for registering the new client.
  • If the service has been contracted through a Telecommunication provider, then the Telecommunication provider will be responsible for registering the new customer.

Finally, the access credentials will be provided to the end customer, who must change their password for security reasons.

You can access your Recordia service by following the instructions on this link.

If they have not supplied you with valid credentials, contact your provider.

articles.title: How to access and log in to Recordia
articles.body_html:
You can access the Recordia website from https://www.recordia.net/.

Use the Log In option in the top-right corner to open the Recordia sign-in page:

Access Recordia

articles.title: Access to the service
articles.body_html:
1. Access to the service

To access the Network Recording service, we must do so through a web browser.

Being a Responsive Interface, it allows access from any device, whether desktop or mobile, which facilitates accessibility from different devices and user experience.

 

2. Login

From the home page, press the login option. Then enter your user credentials and password, as well as the language. Recordia is currently available in English, Catalan, and Spanish.

Login Screen

articles.title: Password recovery
articles.body_html:
In the event that you forget the password, you can recover it by accessing it through the option Forgot password? where the user will enter to receive an email that allows the account credentials to be restored.

 

Detail Password Recovery Option

articles.title: Home screen options
articles.body_html:
When you access Recordia® by default you will do so on the home page where you will have a series of statistics about the service and its use.

In the top menu you will have access to the following options that will vary based on the different functionalities contracted:

 

Detail of Access to the different modules of the Recordia®

 

  1. Home (Statistics): On the home screen you will find the Control Panel with the system usage statistics. In a graphical way, Recordia® shows information about the number of recordings, the recording time, and the numbers or extensions with the highest number of recordings. By default, the data relating to the last week are displayed, being able to configure it according to your needs.
  2. Interactions: This interface displays the default recordings of the last week. Here we can filter by various search criteria the recordings object of our interest and access other operations such as playback, history, and download depending on our privileges.
  3. Cases: Here is a classification of cases or categories in which calls are classified. You can filter by topic (subject), date, the owner, or authorized so that you will detect the most common cases in the selected period.
  4. Rules: From this interface, the user will be able to set the rules or words from which the calls will be classified by case. These rules can be configured according to both the channel and the language and will be customized for each company.
  5. Reports: In this screen, you can configure automatic reports that will be generated on the platform, both the list of recordings, as well as the list of users, extensions or groups, and the history of users. These auto-generated reports will be sent within the period and to the contact set by the user.
  6. Users: The Users environment lists the tree of users, numbers, and extensions, organized hierarchically. Depending on the permissions it can be managed by registering groups, users and allowing the association of numbers and/or extensions.
  7. Configurations: On this screen, you will find configuration aspects or settings such as recording mode, audio testing, or FTP downloads.
  8. User Profile: In this option are available the options of User Manual, Log Out, and My Profile where you can access personal information and password change.
  9. Notifications: Access in which notifications are listed and presented.

articles.title: Search Filters

The details of the recording show the numbers involved in the call, as well as the date of the recording. In addition, there is a comments field in which users can include annotations associated with that recording.

You may find the case that when you query a call you see that there is an hourglass-shaped icon. This means that the call log has been received in Recordia®, but the contents of the recording are not yet available. 

This state is usually transient, for example, if the recording size is very large. If this condition persists it is indicative that there has been a problem in the upload of the recording so an incident should be opened.
